title: Security
mine.title: My fingerprint
mine.hint: When another computer connects for the first time, it will show you this picture so you can confirm it's really you.
mine.missing: Couldn't find this computer's certificate ({path}). It's created the first time Deskflow starts with encryption.
trustedServers.title: Servers I trust
trustedClients.title: Computers that can connect to this one
noPeerCheck: This server doesn't check the fingerprints of computers that connect (an option from the classic app).
fingerprint.label: Fingerprint {hex}
prompt.client.title: Is this the computer you want to connect to?
prompt.client.body: This is the first time you're connecting to this server. On that computer, open Deskflow and look at “{mine}” in {section}: if the picture matches this one, it's the right computer.
prompt.server.title: A new computer wants to connect
prompt.server.body: On the computer that's connecting, open Deskflow and look at “{mine}” in {section}: if the picture matches this one, let it in.
prompt.localPrint: This computer's fingerprint (in case the other one asks for it)
name.label: Name of this computer
name.hint: The name only helps you recognize it here: the fingerprint decides who can connect.
